verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an LLM observability platform. The only evidence of a bulk action is a hands-on community report that Helicone lets users export all their requests at once. A first-party query endpoint (POST /v1/request/query) and HQL support multi-record retrieval, but retrieval is a query, not a bulk operation. Missing for 10: first-party docs for bulk actions (bulk edit, tag, delete, re-run or score across many requests), a documented bulk export API, documented scale limits, and independent corroboration beyond one user comment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: I like that Helicone allows me to see each request and export them all, so that I can use that to build my fine-tuning dataset.
